_comment: WorldBench V5 SCENE DEFINITION — planet generation's fifth generation (resonance fields), beside Populous (V4), which it does not touch. Same bench frame: window stack → paged_menu (page rail + per-page tab rail) → panel | RTT | panel → nav footer. The behaviour (`worldbench`) parses this tree once, worldbench.lua's arrange() lights the selected slice, the globe draws in the centre pane.

children._comment: One tab per FIELD with controls; each option's `enabled_bind` is its field's tab-enabled key published from the FIELDS tree — a disabled field's tab dims, takes no click, and the rail's step skips it.
LEFT PANE — the selected field's dials, one gated slice per tab. Every dial stages pad steps until Confirm.
RIGHT PANE — the FIELDS tree (always shown) above the selected tab's readouts.
THE FIELD TREE (indent = child, which inherits its parent's enable): WAVE › mask, ridge · the three harmonics › mask · COAST · HEAT › EMITTERS.

worldbench_globe._comment: The WORLDBENCH V5 globe — the hex world drawn into the centre viewport, same authored vocabulary as the Populous globe: NO `camera` block (the scene's orbit camera owns the view), `clear` transparent so the holder panel shows through, the near-black under-shell and the inset tile shell over it (the seams between tiles ARE the outlines), the shared reference frame above both. The bench EXTRUDES both shells per cell by the wave's relief and tints the tile shell by the `wave` style block; the radii, insets and static colours stay authored here.
worldbench_globe._hdr: HDR: the `scene` pass (the globe's two shells + graticule, the layers above) renders into the LINEAR rgba16f `hdr` working attachment and `tonemap_grade` resolves it (ACES roll-off) into the sRGB `color` last. grade_strength 0 = tonemap only, no invented tint — an art grade is Aaron's to author in-window. Alpha passes through, so the transparent clear the holder panel shows through survives.

nav_footer._comment: Bench nav rail band (the materialbench/catalog block, same values). `frame` = the node's own slab; `rule` (top hairline) + `label` (legend ink) resolve as the component's defaults.
nav_footer.label: $dim

rtt_holder._comment: The framed RTT HOLDER every bench's rtt/viewport slot styles against — the shared chrome for an offscreen-view slot (replaced the per-scene meshbench holder block, same values).

load._comment: The bootstrap-roll progress bar reuses the loading-screen gauge look (same values as Loading.scene.json load.gauge); per-scene styles by design, palette tokens single-sourced in ui_theme.json.

wave._comment: The WAVE expression's ink (five-line split: palette tokens here, numbers to the Rust). `trough`→`mean`→`crest` is the relief ramp over the wave's normalized value; `sea` is the translucent sphere's colour, `sea_alpha` its blend, `sea_gloss` its wet sheen.
